# Editorial image fixture

`editorial-image.png` is an original synthetic 320 × 180 RGB checkerboard, created for automated CMS upload, preview and anonymous-publication tests. Alternating 40 × 30 cells use RGB (17, 73, 54) and (202, 164, 72). It contains no photograph, third-party content, metadata identifying a person, or production claim. Tests assert the decoded width and visually capture this conspicuous fixture instead of relying on an invisible one-pixel image.
